framing: Soft even studio lighting, no cast shadows, plain light gray background, single subject centered, whole body visible with margin around it, no text, no props, no ground plane.

poses.tpose: Character turnaround reference sheet, front view, strict T-pose: both arms stretched perfectly horizontal straight out to the sides at shoulder height like the letter T, elbows straight, palms down, fingers spread apart, legs straight and a little apart, facing the camera. Nothing overlaps the body: a tail, if any, sticks out sideways, fully visible and clear of the legs.
poses.humanoid: Character turnaround reference sheet, front view, strict T-pose: both arms stretched perfectly horizontal straight out to the sides at shoulder height like the letter T, elbows straight, palms down, fingers spread apart, legs straight and a little apart, facing the camera, a person built like a small human.
poses.quadruped: Character reference, side view from the left, standing neutral on all four straight legs, legs a little apart so none overlap, head up turned slightly toward the camera, tail stretched straight out behind, fully visible and clear of the body and legs.
poses.hexapod: Character reference, side view from the left, standing on all six legs, the legs spread apart so none overlap, head and antennae up, the whole body fully visible.
poses.wings: Front view, standing upright on its feet facing the camera, both wings spread wide open to the sides like a T-pose, every wing feather visible, tail feathers pointing down.
poses.spread: Three-quarter front view from slightly above, standing with all legs spread wide so none overlap, claws raised and open, the whole body fully visible.
poses.flippers: Three-quarter front view from slightly above, all four flippers stretched out flat to the sides, head forward, the whole body fully visible.
poses.object: Three-quarter front view, the whole object visible, standing on its base.

pose_hold.tpose: Same strict T-pose: arms stretched horizontally out to the sides, legs straight.
pose_hold.humanoid: Same strict T-pose: arms stretched horizontally out to the sides, legs straight, built like a small human.
pose_hold.quadruped: Standing on all four paws like a real four-legged animal, never upright on the hind legs.
pose_hold.hexapod: Standing on all six legs like a real insect, legs spread apart, antennae up.
pose_hold.wings: Standing upright with both wings spread wide open to the sides.
pose_hold.spread: Standing with all legs spread wide, claws raised and open.
pose_hold.flippers: All four flippers stretched out flat to the sides.

views.front: seen straight from the front, facing the camera head-on
views.left: seen exactly from the side in profile, the character faces to the left edge of the image, its left side toward the camera
views.back: seen straight from behind, its back toward the camera, the face not visible
views.right: seen exactly from the side in profile, the character faces to the right edge of the image, its right side toward the camera
